site_title: KMI Energy - Empowering Global Energy | Noise Reduction & Power Solutions
hero_h1: Integrated On-Site Power Solutions for Data Centers, Industrial Facilities & Energy Infrastructure
hero_p: Engineering, equipment integration, acoustic compliance, commissioning support, and lifecycle services through one accountable partner.
about_h3: Powering Every Megawatt of the Future
about_p1: Amid the surge in global power demand driven by the AI era, scalable on-site power solutions are becoming critical infrastructure. DataPower focuses on on-site power solutions, designing and delivering power plants for grid stability, large industrial projects, and mining operations.
about_p2: Our flexible, modular power generation systems can rapidly deploy megawatts of capacity in just weeks, avoiding the years required for traditional grid expansion. We are also a premium supplier for Dongfang Electric and AECC, serving global clients with technological innovation, highly competitive ROI (1/5 the price of traditional brands), and agile delivery cycles.
biz_sub: Five major business segments building a full life-cycle guarantee system for energy and industrial equipment
biz1_p: Targeting the noise control needs of energy and industrial equipment. Providing standardized and customized soundproof enclosures for gas turbine OEMs like GE and Siemens Energy. Offering turnkey solutions from acoustic design, product R&D to CFD thermal/ventilation analysis.
biz2_p: DataPower's flexible modular power generation systems can be deployed in weeks. An on-site core energy engine specifically designed to support AI computing centers, large industrial, and mining projects.
biz3_p: As a key front-end device for gas turbine power systems, it is responsible for stabilizing, regulating, and filtering high-pressure natural gas. It's the 'brain and safety valve' of the combustion system, ensuring impurity-free natural gas injection and preventing pressure fluctuation damage.
biz4_p: Through an international partner network, we provide inspection support, scheduled maintenance coordination, overhaul management, performance optimization, and diagnostic services.
maint_h3: Ensuring Stable Output Throughout the Equipment Life Cycle
maint_p: Relying on our localized engineering teams established globally, we provide professional inspection, maintenance, technical upgrades, and diagnostic services for gas turbines and natural gas generator sets.
maint_li1: Rapid Response: Localized layouts achieve the shortest assembly times, reducing downtime risks.
maint_li2: Full-Cycle Service: From daily maintenance and overhauls to performance optimization and spare parts replacement.
maint_li3: Professional Diagnostics: Comprehensive expert-level diagnostic systems for gas turbines and power equipment.
foot_desc: An internationally established turnkey engineering supplier for energy noise reduction and on-site power generation systems.
biz1_hero_p: Decades of engineering and manufacturing experience in industrial noise control, Specialized acoustic engineering for power generation — encompassing gas turbine and generator enclosures, intake and exhaust silencing systems, ventilation acoustic design, and CFD-supported thermal analysis.
biz1_str1_d: Over 40,000m² production base, imported CNC high-precision machining centers, automatic painting lines.
biz1_str2_d: Microcrystalline damping and noise reduction technology, professional acoustic laboratory, R&D team of over 160 people.

biz1_products.desc: Integrating modern manufacturing, construction engineering, acoustic technology, and aesthetics. An environmentally friendly equipment designed to improve and control severe noise pollution.

biz1_products.desc: Isolating a quiet room in a noisy environment, commonly used for product testing and special occasions requiring an absolutely silent environment.

biz2_service_p: With over 20 years of expertise in global industrial power equipment, we supply new and professionally refurbished gas generator sets and genuine spare parts — supported by engineering coordination, multi-OEM sourcing, package integration, FAT, logistics, and commissioning support.
biz3_hero_h1: Fuel Gas Conditioning & Regulation for Power Generation
biz3_hero_p: Precision fuel gas conditioning for turbine and engine inlets — from pipeline interface to combustion-ready gas.

biz3_products.title: Fuel Gas Conditioning Skids
biz3_products.desc: Complete gas train packages integrating pressure regulation, filtration, metering, heating, and safety shut-off — engineered for gas turbine and reciprocating engine inlets. Skid-mounted, factory-tested, ready for on-site tie-in.

biz3_products.title: Gas Filtration & Separation
biz3_products.desc: High-efficiency coalescing filters and cyclone separators delivering 99.8% particulate removal at ≤10μ precision, protecting downstream turbine combustion components from contaminants and liquid carryover.

biz3_products.title: Pressure Regulation & Safety Shut-Off
biz3_products.desc: Multi-stage pressure reduction with active and passive overpressure protection. Series monitoring, slam-shut valves, and fail-safe venting ensure combustion stability and compliance with OEM inlet pressure specifications.

biz3_cases.title: Gas Turbine Fuel Gas Conditioning — 300 MW Combined-Cycle Plant
biz3_cases.desc: Integrated gas conditioning skid for a Siemens Energy SGT5-4000F turbine inlet, covering filtration, heating, pressure regulation, and safety shut-off. Delivered as a single factory-tested module.

biz3_cases.title: Reciprocating Engine Fuel Gas System — Industrial Captive Power Station
biz3_cases.desc: Multi-engine gas train package supplying conditioned fuel gas to 12 × 2 MW Jenbacher generator sets, with individual engine metering and emergency shutdown per string.

biz3_cases.title: Pipeline Gas to Turbine Interface — Floating Power Barge
biz3_cases.desc: Compact, weight-optimized gas conditioning module for a barge-mounted LM2500 gas turbine, meeting maritime classification requirements with full pressure reduction and filtration in a single lift.

biz3_cases.title: Emergency Shut-Off & Vent System — AI Data Center Backup Power
biz3_cases.desc: High-response safety shut-off and nitrogen-purge vent skid for a data center standby gas generation plant, achieving full line isolation within 2 seconds of ESD activation.

biz4_hero_p: An international partner network delivering full-lifecycle support — from major overhauls to performance optimization — across 36 countries and regions.

biz4_services.title: Inspection & Diagnostics
biz4_services.desc: On-site condition monitoring including vibration analysis, borescope inspection, and thermographic scanning. Diagnostic reports identify issues before they become unplanned outages.

biz4_services.title: Scheduled Maintenance
biz4_services.desc: Preventive and predictive maintenance aligned with OEM intervals. Oil sampling, filter replacement, control system checks, and functional testing to maintain reliability.

biz4_services.title: Overhaul Coordination
biz4_services.desc: End-to-end overhaul management — from outage planning and parts procurement to on-site execution, post-overhaul testing, and return-to-service verification.

biz4_services.title: Performance Optimization
biz4_services.desc: Data-driven analysis of operating parameters, fuel consumption trends, and emissions compliance. Actionable recommendations to improve efficiency and extend asset life.

biz4_services.title: Spare Parts Planning
biz4_services.desc: Strategic inventory planning for critical and long-lead spare parts. Ensuring availability when needed while minimizing capital tied up in inventory.
